scope: Each declared parameter checked for meaning, native applicability, type/unit/bounds, conditional source/revision and proposals; retained NIS scenario requirements independently classified.
All nine guideline channel rows and eight exact StdXcvr rows reviewed separately; rounded78k/39k, exact78125/39063, PL3987 versus156250 interface and conflictingFOpriority16 versus4 not conflated.

TPFT loading/topology/wire/path/PSU, TPXF cable worst-versus-typical and temperature populations, FOqualified25m/reference10MHz timing, PLband/coupling and UDP/IP852 examined with actual source qualification.

LonTalk3 addressing/domain lengths, group ACK limits, NeuronID, LPDU/CRC, services/authentication, strict predictiveCSMA beta and recommendation-scoped transaction timers checked. Decimal strict bounds reject equality without epsilon broadening; I2C interpolation regression preserved.

Neuron2.2 message/NV/encoded-buffer limits and conditional compiler proposals; receive-transaction workload rules; actual router-side combined queue plus record/application memory independently checked for RTR10 firmwareA1500/B1408/C1500. Old generic1254 claim not applied across firmware.
Selected ten-file regression7578PASS, isolated SQL with no production database access; includes persisted native-field preservation and foreign legacy bitrate rejection.
